Guidance & outlook: Our total consolidated income for H1 FY 2026 grew by 140.93 %.
Year on year to 84.98 crores including other income, we closed at 88.29 crores compared to 36.65 crores in H1 FY 2025.
EBITDA rose from 16.32 crores in H1 FY 2025 to 28.62 crores this year, With a margin of 32.41 %, and net profit increased from 8.27 crores to 20.68 crores with a margin of 23.43 %.
